sourceVersion: Fontana Unified 2025-2026 School Calendar, Board Approved 9/25/24
seoTitle: Fontana Unified Calendar 2025-2026 | Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Fontana Unified Calendar 2025-2026 with first day, last day, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, minimum days, Spanish PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: Fontana Unified starts the 2025-2026 school year on August 6, 2025 and ends on May 28, 2026. The board-approved calendar lists Fall Break from November 24-28, Winter Break from December 22-January 9, Spring Break from March 23-27, weekly Wednesday minimum days, elementary and middle school conference minimum days from October 20-24, high school final exam minimum days from December 16-19 and May 26-28, and a Spanish school year calendar PDF.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Fontana Unified start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fontana Unified starts school on Wednesday, August 6, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fontana Unified Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, November 24 through Friday, November 28, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fontana Unified Winter Break in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Friday, January 9, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fontana Unified Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 23 through Friday, March 27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Fontana Unified in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for all grades is Thursday, May 28, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Fontana Unified have weekly minimum days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official calendar notes that all schools have minimum days on Wednesdays each week.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Fontana Unified calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the Fontana Unified ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

customSections.label: How We Verify Fontana Unified Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official Fontana Unified school year calendars page and board-approved calendar PDFs, then compares key dates such as first day, last day, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, professional development days, member directed days, minimum days, conference windows, semester dates, and finals windows before converting the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official Fontana Unified calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.
